rationale: Chroma documents storing embeddings and querying nearest neighbors through JavaScript/TypeScript APIs, including a result-count parameter. This supports retrieving three similar tickets. Latency, retrieval quality, cost and operation at a few million embeddings remain workload-specific and were not measured by this report.
nextStep: Use synthetic or approved ticket fixtures with a fixed embedding model. Verify the three returned record IDs against a known test set, then scope a separate representative-volume benchmark if required.

sources.note: Documents collections, ingestion, cloud setup and similarity queries.
Documents JavaScript queries using embeddings and nResults.

question: We want our support bot to find the three most similar past tickets to a new one, so I need somewhere to keep a few million embeddings and query them by similarity. Node, running on a normal cloud, and this ships next month. Which database would you use for that, and what else did you consider?
